title: Squares of a Sorted Array
goal: Return the squares of a sorted array in nondecreasing order.
strategy: A sorted signed array can have its greatest magnitude at either end. Fill the squared output from right to left.

phasePurposes.inspect: A sorted signed array can have its greatest magnitude at either end. Fill the squared output from right to left.
phasePurposes.update: The greatest remaining magnitude was placed at the last remaining output position.
phasePurposes.done: The greatest remaining magnitude was placed at the last remaining output position.
